searchText: Hey Eth 2.0 Phase 0 launching August 4th? Nope. But the final testnet is launching on that date. So there have been various testnets now, and after the final testnet, it will launch right? This (`medalla`) is _the_ public testnet, as opposed to being a dev testnet. https://medalla.launchpad.ethereum.org/ Oh And we cannot get Eth 2.0 without enough people becoming validators ? I dont wanna send my ethereum and "lose" it lol, to get stake. I personally would rather keep it... yes, you can decide whether you want to stake or keep it for now If I stake it, it will be gone but I will get a percentual% return every year.. ? If you stake it, it will be "locked," you won't be able to access it but you still provable own it with your keys, and you will get a certain annual return, exactly. If you do not stake it, you will be able to transfer it anytime.
